_about: Limits for the real style's road, for tools/look.mjs --check against tools/look/surface.json (npm run check:surface): the asphalt has a grain, patches and cracks, a road that is wet holds the lamps, and none of it costs a call or a triangle. surface.json is what the page gave of the same four shots without the grain. A rule: { shot, metric, min, max }, or against it: { ..., of: 'baseline', maxRatio, minAdd }.

rules.why: the asphalt has a grain, neither a smooth slab nor a speckle: how much a pixel of the road differs from its four neighbours in L is 0.030 to 0.060 (0.0576 measured, 0.0348 without the grain)
the road 60 to 150 m off does not flicker as the car goes: how much it changes in a sixtieth of a second is at most 1.15 of what it was without the grain (0.0073 measured, 0.0096 without the grain)
the grain, the patches and the wear leave the road about as light as it was (0.4472 measured, 0.4301 without the grain)
